title: This can help land you an interview ✍️
description:
If you’ve been reaching out to recruiters and not hearing back, try this instead. You only get one shot at at first impression so make sure you’re not just saying “hi”. Be concise with your message but provide details on the role and mention you’ve already applied. You don’t want to overload the recruiter with a huge message that they will just pass over but you also don’t want to send something so short there’s no reason to respond. #jobsearch #jobsearchtips #jobsearchhelp
